directive.quote: finish the source-repo-a port so the repo can be retired and renamed source-repo-a-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: generate-and-judge-sound-effects: byte copies of the sound-effect sourcing, palette and judging scripts

preserve: a one-shot candidate is trimmed by earshot find plus refine, a swell or long tail whole
a lead-in is cut so its peak sits where the real one peaks, keeping its length; one that builds for too short a time is not eligible
the pick is the highest match z among candidates at or under the saturation share
the pick is scaled to the real sound's active-part RMS, never above -1 dBFS peak, and A/B-compared with it
naming sounds judges only those again and keeps the other picks
allowed_deltas: which sounds, their queries, the generators and their globs, group_of, lead_in, whole, not_from_pick_of, max_saturated and least_build are the request's or the settings record's
a sound with no clean eligible candidate is a named refusal instead of a crash
paths, the person's words and tuned values come from argv or a request file instead of the source repository's folders and constants
the last line printed is {"result": ...} or {"error": ...}
banned_substitutions: a second copy of this job in another Workshop tool
the person's words or thresholds written into the code
